items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...he said, I remember Hawk playing 'cello with Raymond Smith. [INTERVIEWEE] He could play cello. He used to double on cello.

ctx.x: Well, you know that a funny thing -- I think it was when Harry Carney died. I was at that funeral home when the first person (unintelligible) -- well, he's a sax -- an old saxophone player. Lives We used to go out in Long Island. And I was talking to him, and he said, I remember Hawk playing 'cello with Raymond Smith.
He could play cello. He used to double on cello.
